violet: Heads-up — ran into a confusing onboarding flow where a user-supplied REDWOOD_API_KEY got silently swapped for an org-default when REDWOOD_PROJECT was set. Repro and logs below.

max: ouch. can you paste the minimal repro?

violet: repro:
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=pk_dev_17
export REDWOOD_PROJECT=team-omega
rw demo start
logs: "env key found: pk_dev_17" then "project metadata returned fallback key pk_org_42 -> switching active key". afterwards requests go to org tenant.

ash: that flow should never overwrite an explicit env var. expected precedence: CLI flag > ENV > config file > project metadata. sounds like project path is short-circuiting.

max: is this from the recent auth-chain refactor? I remember we changed how ProjectProvider is invoked.

violet: yep — auth/chain.ts now does `if (process.env.REDWOOD_PROJECT) return ProjectProvider.resolve()` early, and ProjectProvider will return an org default on fallback without checking env/flag first.

ci-bot: created issue DEVEX-5112: project-metadata overriding explicit credentials when REDWOOD_PROJECT set. PR template linked.

ash: short fix: change resolver so it checks `process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY` and `argv['--api-key']` before querying metadata. Very small change.

max: also propose two UX improvements: 1) `rw auth:whoami` that prints effective key source (flag|env|file|project-metadata), 2) a non-fatal local warning when project metadata would cause a tenant switch. helps support troubleshooting.

violet: agree. add telemetry/audit event for org-fallbacks so product can see how often this happens silently.

nora: for support playbook: if a user reports wrong tenant, ask for `rw auth:whoami --json` and advise `unset REDWOOD_PROJECT` while debugging or pass `--api-key` explicitly. I'll add that to the support FAQ.

max: tests to add: env+project (env wins), flag+project (flag wins), project-rotation fallback (emit warning + telemetry), and batch/stream stability so we don't mutate creds mid-request.

violet: I'll open PR with small resolver change, add `auth:whoami`, emit audit log on fallback, and update sampleapp README with a short note for local devs. will ping when CI passes.

nora: thanks! once merged I'll add the playbook entry and a short docs blurb for the quickstarts. saves a bunch of confused new users. :white_check_mark:
